422.headline: A parting that falls like your own hair
422.story: You brush your hair to the side and it falls the way hair does: softly, a little heavy, with light highlights where the light catches it. Andrea has worked with hair since she was nineteen, beginning in Rio de Janeiro. One thing has never left her: it has to be real. This V-toupee is waiting in her atelier in Iserlohn: 46 cm of dark blonde with light highlights, and this one piece exists only once.
benefits: An ultra-thin, skin-coloured base → the hair sits right up to its edge, so that, as far as possible, no rim shows through.
At the front the base opens into a narrow V → from there the hair falls to both sides, the way a parting forms by itself.
Human hair in dark blonde with light highlights → you blow-dry, straighten and style it like your own hair, with heat protection.
46 cm in length → enough for your hairdresser to match it exactly to your hairstyle.
A single piece, confirmed personally → you only pay once Andrea has confirmed the piece to you.
422.howItWorks: A topper is a hairpiece for the crown: it is placed on your own hair, and its lengths blend with the hair underneath and beside it. On this piece the base is cut out in a V at the front; the hair is worked in all the way to the edge and falls from there to both sides.
422.goodFor: For women whose hair has become thinner on the crown and who would like more visual fullness there without giving up their own hair. The colour suits dark blonde hair with lighter areas.
care: Before washing, gently detangle from the ends towards the root.
Wash with a mild, sulphate-free shampoo; apply conditioner to the lengths only and treat the base gently.
Let it air-dry; use a hairdryer, straightener or curling iron only with heat protection.

faq.q: Can people tell that I'm wearing a topper?
faq.a: This question deserves an honest answer: it depends on how colour, length and density match your hair and how the topper sits. Andrea goes through exactly that with you before you pay.

faq.q: Does the colour match my hair?
faq.a: Screens show colours differently. Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight, without flash. She will tell you openly whether this piece suits you, and only then do you pay.

Andrea discusses with you how the topper is attached before payment, to suit your own hair. If you are unsure whether your hair will hold the attachment well, tell her. That is what the conversation is for.

423.headline: Long hair for tonight – and your own again tomorrow
423.story: You let your hair down, shake your head, and it falls long and heavy down your back. By the next morning it is shoulder-length again, just as you know it. Clip-ins make both possible: three wefts of human hair in natural dark brown that you put in yourself and take out again in the evening. No appointment, no glue.
benefits: Clips instead of glue → each day you decide anew whether you want to wear length today.
Three wefts with 8 clips in total (two wider ones with 3 each, one narrower with 2) → you spread the length over several rows, and it falls all around.
Human hair → you style it like your own: blow-dry, straighten, curl, with heat protection.
194 g in the set → you know exactly how much hair you are holding in your hand.
No fixed method → you try out long hair before committing to anything permanent.
423.howItWorks: Clip-in wefts are strips of hair with small clips along the top edge. At the back of your head you part your hair horizontally, pin the hair above it up, lightly tease the root area beneath and close the clips close to the root, the middle one first. Your own hair falls over the top and covers the weft. In the evening you open all the clips and take the wefts out.
423.goodFor: For women with roughly shoulder-length or longer hair who want length and fullness without committing to a permanent method. The colour suits naturally dark brown hair.
care: Take them out before sleeping and before showering.
Wash the wefts separately: mild, sulphate-free shampoo, lukewarm water, let them air-dry.
Before washing and after wearing, comb gently starting at the ends.
Store them lying flat or hanging so that nothing tangles.

faq.a: The clips sit close to the root beneath a layer of your own hair, which falls over them and covers them. For the transition to look harmonious, the colour above all should match. So send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight beforehand, without flash.

The clips hold best close to the root on lightly teased hair. Clip-ins are meant for the day and are taken out in the evening. If your hair is very fine, tell Andrea beforehand; professionals then advise against wearing clip-ins every day.

faq.q: Can I manage it on my own?
faq.a: Clip-ins are made for putting in yourself. The first few times take a little longer; at the back of your head a hand mirror or a second pair of eyes helps at first.

424.headline: The long, dark hair that never wanted to grow for you
424.story: In the morning you tie a ponytail, and it reaches further than your hair ever has. You let it slide through your hand and feel the weight of real hair. Behind it is a weft with an especially flat seam: Genius Weft lies close to the head, and from it hang 55 cm of human hair in natural dark brown.
benefits: Genius Weft has a flat seam with no hair at the back → the row lies close to the head and adds little bulk, even when you wear your hair down.
Genius Weft can be cut at any point → the weft is adapted to the shape of your head, not the other way round.
Human hair → you blow-dry, straighten and curl it like your own hair, with heat protection.
50 g per pack → you combine as many packs as you need for your goal; how many that is and whether enough are in stock, Andrea will tell you personally.
424.howItWorks: Genius Weft is applied by a hairdresser or extension specialist. She sets a row of small rings along a horizontal line of your own hair and attaches the weft to them, usually by sewing it in. Because the seam is so flat, the row lies close to the head. As your own hair grows out, the weft is moved up; when, your hairdresser decides.
424.goodFor: For anyone who wants more length or density for the long term and is willing to book an appointment with a specialist. Because of the flat seam, Genius Weft is often chosen for fine to medium hair.
care: Apply shampoo to the root and scalp, conditioner and treatment only to the lengths, not to the seam.
Let the row dry completely after washing before you go to bed.
Brush from the ends upwards and support the row with your hand as you do.
Braid your hair loosely at night.

faq.a: The seam is very flat and lies close to the head, with your own hair falling over it. How discreet the result is depends on the placement, the colour and your hairstyle, for example with high ponytails. Your hairdresser therefore plans the row together with you.

The hold comes from the application: the weft is attached to a row of small rings in your own hair. Genius Weft is a fixed method for everyday life, not just for an evening. As your hair grows out, your hairdresser moves the row up.

faq.q: Does natural dark brown suit me?
faq.a: Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight, without flash. Before you pay, she will tell you whether the shade matches and how many packs you need for your goal.

425.headline: Long golden blonde with depth – made to be worn loose
425.story: You stand at the window, turn your head, and the light travels through your hair, from one blonde into the next. That is how an ombré works: the colour flows along the length instead of changing in one place. This Genius Weft carries golden blonde in a gradient on an especially flat seam that lies close to the head, so that you can wear your hair down.
benefits: Golden blonde ombré → your hair does not look like a single shade but like many that flow into one another.
Genius Weft has a flat seam with no hair at the back → the row lies close to the head and adds little bulk, even when you wear your hair down.
Genius Weft can be cut at any point → the weft is adapted to the shape of your head, not the other way round.
50 g per pack → you combine as many packs as you need for your goal; how many that is and whether enough are in stock, Andrea will tell you personally.
425.howItWorks: Genius Weft is attached by a hairdresser or extension specialist to a row of small rings in your own hair, usually by sewing it in. The flat seam lets the row lie close to the head. As your hair grows out, the weft is moved up; your hairdresser decides when.
425.goodFor: For blonde hair that is to gain length or fullness, and for anyone who likes a soft colour gradient. Because of the flat seam, Genius Weft is often chosen for fine to medium hair.
care: Shampoo at the root and scalp, conditioner and treatment only on the lengths, not on the seam.
Let the row dry completely after washing before you go to bed.
Use heat only with heat protection; brush from the ends upwards and support the row with your hand as you do.

faq.a: Blonde has many nuances, and screens distort them. Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight, without flash, ideally showing the root and the ends. Before you pay, she will tell you honestly whether the ombré suits you.

The seam is very flat and lies close to the head, with your own hair falling over it. How discreet the result is depends on the placement, the colour and your hairstyle. Your hairdresser therefore plans the row together with you.
The hold comes from the application to a row of small rings in your own hair. Genius Weft is a fixed method for everyday life. As your hair grows out, your hairdresser moves the row up.

426.headline: More curls, more length – and everything stays curly
426.story: You shake your head and the curls spring back, only longer than yesterday. You don't have to straighten anything for it: this Genius Weft is naturally curly itself, in coffee brown with a copper ombré, and falls with your curls. Behind it is a weft with an especially flat seam, close to the head.
benefits: Naturally curly texture → your curls gain length and remain what they are.
Coffee brown with a copper ombré → a warm gradient that plays through the curls.
Genius Weft has a flat seam with no hair at the back → the row lies close to the head and adds little bulk.
50 g per pack → you combine as many packs as you need for your goal; how many that is and whether enough are in stock, Andrea will tell you personally.
426.howItWorks: Genius Weft is attached by a hairdresser or extension specialist to a row of small rings in your own hair, usually by sewing it in. The seam of a Genius Weft is flat and can be cut at any point, so that the width fits the shape of your head. As your hair grows out, the weft is moved up.
426.goodFor: For curly hair that is to become longer or fuller without giving up its own texture. The colour suits brown hair with warm, coppery tones.
care: Shampoo at the root and scalp, conditioner and treatment only on the lengths, not on the seam.
Let the row dry completely after washing before you go to bed.
At night braid your hair loosely or put it up so that the lengths do not tangle.

faq.a: Curls are as different as the people who wear them. Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight, without flash. Before you pay, she will tell you whether texture and colour suit you.

The seam is very flat and lies close to the head, with your own curls falling over it. How discreet the result is depends on the placement and your hairstyle. It is best applied by a specialist with experience of curly hair.
The hold comes from the application to a row of small rings in your own hair. Genius Weft is a fixed method for everyday life. As your hair grows out, your hairdresser moves the row up.

427.headline: Blonde and long – and your dark root is welcome to stay
427.story: You brush your hair back, and at the root you see what was always there: a darker blonde that turns lighter. These extensions play with exactly that transition: light blonde in an ombré, with a dark root at the top. The hair is worn on Invisible Tapes, thin, flat adhesive strips that lie close to the head.
benefits: Dark root in the ombré → the transition to your own, darker root becomes softer, and your blonde can grow out naturally.
A thin, flat adhesive strip → the tapes lie close to the head, even when you change your parting or brush your hair back.
Hair right up to the edge of the tape → the strand starts directly at the strip and falls from there into your own hair.
25 g per pack → your hairdresser places the hair in fine amounts exactly where you want it.
427.howItWorks: Invisible Tape is a variant of the tape-in method. The hair sits on an adhesive strip that is attached close to the root to fine strands of your own hair. With Invisible Tape this strip is thinner and flatter than with a classic tape, and the hair is set right up to its edge. Application, repositioning and removal are carried out by a hairdresser or extension specialist.
427.goodFor: For blonde hair with a darker root that is to gain length or density. Invisible Tape is often chosen for fine hair, and by those who change their parting or like to wear their hair up.
care: Do not wash for the first 48 hours after application.
Use sulphate-free shampoo; keep conditioner and oil away from the tapes.
Blow-dry the root straight after washing and do not sleep with wet hair.
Brush dry only, from the ends upwards.

faq.a: The tapes are thin and flat and lie close to the head. When professionally applied, they blend discreetly into your own hair. How well depends also on your hair texture, the placement and your hairstyle; so talk through your favourite hairstyles with your hairdresser beforehand.

faq.q: And what if the colour doesn't match after all?
faq.a: The surest way is to send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight before you order. Check the colour after receipt, before you peel off protective films or have anything applied. You can withdraw within 14 days of receiving the goods. If you go beyond that check, for example because protective films have been peeled off or tapes applied, you may have to pay compensation for the loss in value; the details are in the withdrawal notice.

The tapes are attached close to the root to fine strands of your own hair. For a good hold, care matters: do not wash for the first 48 hours, and keep conditioner and oil away from the tapes. As your hair grows out, your hairdresser repositions the tapes.

428.headline: Long, full hair – built up row by row
428.story: You run your hand through your hair, and it lies long and heavy in your palm, well past your shoulders. This is how Butterfly Weft works, in rows: the flat weft is attached to small rings and lies over them so that its hair covers the attachment. Each row brings human hair in natural dark brown, with a weft width of 30 cm.
benefits: The weft lies over the attachment → the rings sit beneath the weft's hair; on top there is only hair.
30 cm weft width per row → the fullness is spread across the width of the back of the head instead of in single strands.
Human hair → you blow-dry, straighten and curl it like your own hair, with heat protection.
50 g per pack → you combine as many packs as you need for your goal; how many that is and whether enough are in stock, Andrea will tell you personally.
428.howItWorks: Butterfly Weft is applied by a hairdresser or extension specialist. She sets a row of small rings in your own hair, usually from ear to ear, and attaches the weft to them. The row has to sit so that your own hair covers it from above. As your hair grows out, the weft is moved up. On the edge of this weft you can see a row of small holes; according to manufacturers, with Butterfly Weft they serve to connect the weft to your own hair.
428.goodFor: For anyone who wants more length and fullness for the long term and is willing to book an appointment with a specialist. The colour suits naturally dark brown hair.
care: Wash with sulphate-free shampoo along the weft, without rubbing at the rings.
Conditioner and treatment only from the middle of the lengths.
Let the row dry completely after washing before you go to bed.
Brush from the ends upwards and support the row with your hand as you do.

faq.a: The weft lies over the rings, and your own hair falls over it from above. How discreet the result is depends on where the row sits and how you wear your hair. Your hairdresser therefore plans the position together with you.
The hold comes from the application to a row of small rings in your own hair. Butterfly Weft is a fixed method for everyday life. As your hair grows out, your hairdresser moves the row up.

faq.q: What is the difference from Genius Weft?
faq.a: Both are flat wefts on a row of rings. With Butterfly Weft the weft lies over the attachment so that its hair covers the rings; Genius Weft is usually sewn in and can be cut at any point. Andrea is happy to discuss with you which method suits your hair.
